Pattern: Average skill score vs KPI achievement
Business_Meaning: Higher KPI achievement should generally align with stronger demonstrated skills.
Performance score is anchored in KPI achievement but also includes quality, teamwork and manager input.
Improving employees should generally receive stronger performance outcomes.
More absence days reduce attendance reliability.
Engaged employees generally collaborate more effectively.
Manager assessment and relationship quality are related, but not identical.
More role-relevant experience generally improves replacement readiness.
Goal completion should strongly reflect KPI delivery.
